fields.description: systimer register version
fields.name: DATE

fields.description: 1: reset, detection of a set reset mode bit results in aborting the current transmission/reception of a message and entering the reset mode. 0: normal, on the '1-to-0' transition of the reset mode bit, the TWAI controller returns to the operating mode.
fields.name: RESET_MODE

fields.description: 1: listen only, in this mode the TWAI controller would give no acknowledge to the TWAI-bus, even if a message is received successfully. The error counters are stopped at the current value. 0: normal.
fields.name: LISTEN_ONLY_MODE

fields.description: 1: self test, in this mode a full node test is possible without any other active node on the bus using the self reception request command. The TWAI controller will perform a successful transmission, even if there is no acknowledge received. 0: normal, an acknowledge is required for successful transmission.
fields.name: SELF_TEST_MODE

fields.description: 1:single, the single acceptance filter option is enabled (one filter with the length of 32 bit is active). 0:dual, the dual acceptance filter option is enabled (two filters, each with the length of 16 bit are active).
fields.name: RX_FILTER_MODE

fields.description: 1: present, a message shall be transmitted. 0: absent
fields.name: TX_REQ

fields.description: 1: present, if not already in progress, a pending transmission request is cancelled. 0: absent
fields.name: ABORT_TX

fields.description: 1: released, the receive buffer, representing the message memory space in the RXFIFO is released. 0: no action
fields.name: RELEASE_BUF

fields.description: 1: clear, the data overrun status bit is cleared. 0: no action.
fields.name: CLEAR_DATA_OVERRUN

fields.description: 1: present, a message shall be transmitted and received simultaneously. 0: absent.
fields.name: SELF_RX_REQUEST

fields.description: 1: full, one or more complete messages are available in the RXFIFO. 0: empty, no message is available
fields.name: RX_BUF_ST

fields.description: 1: overrun, a message was lost because there was not enough space for that message in the RXFIFO. 0: absent, no data overrun has occurred since the last clear data overrun command was given
fields.name: OVERRUN

fields.description: 1: released, the CPU may write a message into the transmit buffer. 0: locked, the CPU cannot access the transmit buffer, a message is either waiting for transmission or is in the process of being transmitted
fields.name: TX_BUF_ST

fields.description: 1: complete, last requested transmission has been successfully completed. 0: incomplete, previously requested transmission is not yet completed
fields.name: TRANSMISSION_COMPLETE

fields.description: 1: receive, the TWAI controller is receiving a message. 0: idle
fields.name: RECEIVE

fields.description: 1: transmit, the TWAI controller is transmitting a message. 0: idle
fields.name: TRANSMIT

fields.description: 1: error, at least one of the error counters has reached or exceeded the CPU warning limit defined by the Error Warning Limit Register (EWLR). 0: ok, both error counters are below the warning limit
fields.name: ERR

fields.description: 1: bus-off, the TWAI controller is not involved in bus activities. 0: bus-on, the TWAI controller is involved in bus activities
fields.name: BUS_OFF_ST

fields.description: 1: current message is destroyed because of FIFO overflow.
fields.name: MISS_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set while the receive FIFO is not empty and the RIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: RECEIVE_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set whenever the transmit buffer status changes from '0-to-1' (released) and the TIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: TRANSMIT_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set on every change (set and clear) of either the error status or bus status bits and the EIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: ERR_WARNING_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set on a '0-to-1' transition of the data overrun status bit and the DOIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: DATA_OVERRUN_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set whenever the TWAI controller has reached the error passive status (at least one error counter exceeds the protocol-defined level of 127) or if the TWAI controller is in the error passive status and enters the error active status again and the EPIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: ERR_PASSIVE_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set when the TWAI controller lost the arbitration and becomes a receiver and the ALIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: ARBITRATION_LOST_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set when the TWAI controller detects an error on the TWAI-bus and the BEIE bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: BUS_ERR_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: this bit is set when the TWAI controller detects state of TWAI become IDLE and this interrupt enable bit is set within the interrupt enable register. 0: reset
fields.name: IDLE_INT_ST

fields.description: 1: enabled, when the receive buffer status is 'full' the TWAI controller requests the respective interrupt. 0: disable
fields.name: EXT_RECEIVE_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, when a message has been successfully transmitted or the transmit buffer is accessible again (e.g. after an abort transmission command), the TWAI controller requests the respective interrupt. 0: disable
fields.name: EXT_TRANSMIT_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, if the error or bus status change (see status register. Table 14), the TWAI controllerrequests the respective interrupt. 0: disable
fields.name: EXT_ERR_WARNING_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, if the data overrun status bit is set (see status register. Table 14), the TWAI controllerrequests the respective interrupt. 0: disable
fields.name: EXT_DATA_OVERRUN_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, if the error status of the TWAI controller changes from error active to error passive or vice versa, the respective interrupt is requested. 0: disable
fields.name: ERR_PASSIVE_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, if the TWAI controller has lost arbitration, the respective interrupt is requested. 0: disable
fields.name: ARBITRATION_LOST_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, if an bus error has been detected, the TWAI controller requests the respective interrupt. 0: disable
fields.name: BUS_ERR_INT_ENA

fields.description: 1: enabled, if state of TWAI become IDLE, the TWAI controller requests the respective interrupt. 0: disable
fields.name: IDLE_INT_ENA

fields.description: PWM timer0 start and stop control. 0: if PWM timer0 starts, then stops at TEZ, 1: if timer0 starts, then stops at TEP, 2: PWM timer0 starts and runs on, 3: timer0 starts and stops at the next TEZ, 4: timer0 starts and stops at the next TEP. TEP here and below means the event that happens when the timer equals to period

fields.description: PWM timer0 working mode, 0: freeze, 1: increase mode, 2: decrease mode, 3: up-down mode

fields.name: SW

fields.name: TIMER0_PHASE

edge of SCL, in I2C module clock cycles.

edge of SCL and the negative edge of SDA

fields.description: Set this bit to force the request to l2 cache with write-miss-allocate attribute, otherwise, the attribute is propagated from L1 cache or CPU, it could be one of write-miss-allocate and write-miss-no-allocate.
fields.name: L2_CACHE_ACCESS_FORCE_WMA

fields.description: Set this bit to force the request to l2 cache with read-miss-allocate attribute, otherwise, the attribute is propagated from L1 cache or CPU, it could be one of read-miss-allocate and read-miss-no-allocate.
